title: Project onboarding
text: The Run /yoke onboard module completes when the project's first item is done; no separate first-deploy module. Checklist reads fill missing legacy rows in memory from seeding defaults without changing saved choices, branch or database rows; missing rows do not prove current readiness. Recorded delivery remains historical completion. Unreadable saved evidence returns a typed error only in Overview's onboarding module; other modules remain available.
